snippet.title: Panta Rhei | Release Date Trailer | reignite games
snippet.description:
Panta Rhei releases for PC on July 31st, 2025!

Panta Rhei is a single-player adventure rogue-lite where you wield time itself as your weapon. Become the Guardian of Past and use your time-bending abilities to defeat deviant creatures in tight melee combat while exploring the mythical Realm of Time.

Play the demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1730550/Panta_Rhei/

Join our community: https://discord.com/invite/Bu5Fu9GBGS
